claim.claim: Dividends received by individuals from Malaysian companies are fully exempt from income tax under Section 4A of the Income Tax Act 1967.
claim.entity: individuals (other than companies) receiving dividends from Malaysian companies

results.current_value: Tax is imposed annually on individuals who receive income in respect of :. a) Gains / profit from a business;. b) Gains / profit from employment;. c) Dividends, interest or discounts;. d) Rent, royalties or premiums;. e) Pensions, annuities or other periodic payments; and. f) Gains / profit not falling under any of the foregoing paragraphs.

results.reason: The official pages do not settle this claim.

claim.claim: Non-resident individuals may face 10% withholding tax on dividends instead.

results.current_value: all dividends are tax free in the hands of the shareholders
results.evidence_quote: With the introduction of the single tier dividend system effective 1.1.2008, all dividends are tax free in the hands of the shareholders.
